research_end_to_end_reexecution: PASS - 2026-11-24, on the author's recorded decision, with the finding unchanged rather than withdrawn. Nothing downstream of training reproduces bit-for-bit, because the archived weights predate the repair that made the seed reach the global torch RNG. What made this PARTIAL was that the size of the gap was unknown; it is now measured - three seeds fixed before any replication outcome was inspected, the quarter-count residual 5.09-6.67 times D1 over nine seed-and-condition combinations, published in results/seed_replication_d2.json inside the cited release and stated in the article at Sections 2.3, 2.7, 3.3 and 4.4, so a reader meets it in the Methods and not in a repository file. The D1 and TV arms were not replicated, so the measured spread is the ratio's numerator alone, and the article says that too. The author was shown this and instructed that the gate be closed (publication/reviews/DECISION.md). Prior record follows. PARTIAL - 2026-11-04, and the part that is missing is now measured rather than pending. The whole pipeline was re-executed with tools/run_pipeline.py in a separate tree expanded from git archive v0.2.0, with its own environment built from paper/requirements-manuscript.txt, so nothing it wrote could reach a frozen result: 22 stages, 7.1 hours, from the XCOM and SpekPy reference tables through both training arms to the 60-slice walnut evaluation, then compared leaf by leaf with tools/compare_results.py. Everything that does not pass through a trained network reproduces exactly, at a tolerance of zero: quantitation_baseline (160 leaves), detectability_spectrum (915), tv_eval (670), both walnut noise models with their npz arrays and meta. The training data regenerates byte-identical, 384 of 384 files in each arm. Nothing downstream of training reproduces: all three weight files differ, and so do denoised_eval, denoised_eval_d2, sensitivity_eval, both walnut evaluations and the walnut summary. The cause is not float noise and not the environment. SEED reached a local torch.Generator covering batch order and crop offsets, while the convolution weights were initialised from the global torch RNG, which nothing seeded; two 150-step runs on one machine with one seed and identical data differed in all 46 tensors and in the step-150 training loss (14209.86 against 14246.38). tools/train_denoiser.py and tools/train_denoiser_walnut.py now seed the global RNG through seeded_model(), pinned by tests/test_training_seeding.py and proved by removing the seed again. The weights shipped in v0.2.0 predate that repair and cannot be regenerated by it; they are archived with the release, and clean_new_environment_figure_rebuild separately proved that every shipped figure redraws from them byte-identically. The re-execution also found two defects in the released code: denoised_eval.py wrote the merged result to the working directory rather than results/ when --final was given a bare name, which is the command in its own docstring (fixed, tests/test_eval_output_paths.py), and tv_weight_selection.py's default candidate list is not the one that produced the committed selection. What is still not re-executed is the 19 GB walnut download, tools/fetch_reconstructions.py 2026-11-23: the size of that irreproducibility is now measured rather than unknown. tools/seed_replication_d2.py retrained the D2 arm from three seeds fixed before any outcome was seen (20261019, 20261020, 20261021), on the same pre-generated phantom files and under the same protocol, and ran the frozen six-condition evaluation on each. The quarter-count two-basis residual came out at 4.81-6.35 HU, 5.09-6.67 times D1 over the nine seed-and-condition combinations, so the manuscript's sharpest claim survives every draw and the archived v0.2.0 realization at 5.56-5.59 times D1 sits inside the spread rather than at its favourable edge. The iodine deviation does not behave that way: the penalty improved it in six of the nine combinations, and the seed spread within a condition is as large as the D2-D1 difference itself. Results in results/seed_replication_d2.json; sections 2.3, 2.7, 3.3, 4.4 and the abstract report it. The D1 and TV arms were not retrained, so the spread is that of the ratio's numerator alone.
